description: Only used by `just outdated` (in ansible/), which runs Renovate read-only to list newer versions. No bot, no pull requests.
It reads Dockerfile FROM lines, literal image: lines in compose templates, and '# renovate:' annotated *_version keys in role defaults.
Compose templates with a templated image tag (immich, garage, crafty) are not valid YAML to Renovate and are skipped, which is why those versions live in annotated variables.

customManagers.description: A '# renovate: datasource=docker depName=<image>' comment above any '<name>_version:' key in a role's defaults/main.yml
